responsibility: This C header publishes the foreign-function interface to the mcLexBuf token buffer for C-based lexer code and GCC-side consumers. It exports the current-token globals and the routines for source opening, token buffering, token stream rewinding/insertion, source-location lookup, and include-file stack maintenance, allowing the external scanner to feed mc’s buffered multi-pass parser infrastructure.
same_name_distinction: This .h file is the C-language interface for the mcLexBuf group, declaring extern symbols and entry points with C names for the lexer and GCC-side code. It differs from mcLexBuf.def, which is the Modula-2 definition module, and from mcLexBuf.mod, which implements the token buffer itself.
